source: v1.0 — manual seed (10 items, 2026-05-09). v1.1 — +30 templated queries from chapter docs (no LLM, schema-validation fixtures, expected_chunk_ids still empty pending v2.0 grounding pass).
description: Golden evaluation dataset for hybrid retrieval + RAG quality benchmarks. Each item has a query, expected ground-truth chunk_ids (in pdf_documents collection), expected answer keywords (loose check), and difficulty label.

fields.expected_chunk_ids: list of chunk IDs that should appear in top-K retrieval (gold standard)
fields.expected_keywords: list of strings — answer should mention at least one (loose semantic check)
fields.expected_answer_summary: short ideal answer for human review (not used for automated metric)
fields.difficulty: easy | medium | hard — easy = single-chunk lookup, medium = synthesis across 2-3 chunks, hard = multi-step or analytical

items.query: What embedding model does the framework use after Phase 8?
items.expected_answer_summary: Qwen3-Embedding-8B (4096d) served via TEI Docker. Replaces multilingual-e5-large.

items.query: How does Hybrid Search combine vector and BM25 results?
items.expected_answer_summary: Hybrid Search uses Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to combine dense vector search with BM25 sparse retrieval, optionally adding graph-based search as a third leg.

items.query: Steps to index a PDF document via the CLI
items.expected_answer_summary: Use python -m src.cli index <file.pdf> [--graph] [--raptor] etc. Pipeline: load → split → embed → upsert into Qdrant collection.

items.query: Compare Self-RAG and Adaptive RAG agents
items.expected_answer_summary: Self-RAG performs grading + rewriting + hallucination check. Adaptive RAG classifies the query and routes to a strategy with optional decomposition into sub-queries.

items.query: What reranking strategies are available?
items.expected_answer_summary: Four rerankers: cross-encoder (default), FlashRank (fast), Cohere (cloud), LLM-based (slow but high quality).

items.query: How does the framework handle multi-tenancy isolation?
items.expected_answer_summary: Per-tenant Qdrant collections, JWT-derived tenant_id, IDOR guard via assert_tenant_access on all routes accepting tenant_id from user input.

items.query: Что такое регистр накопления в 1С?
items.expected_answer_summary: Регистр накопления — объект 1С для учёта оборотов и остатков. Поддерживает два вида: остатки и обороты.

items.query: Как реализован Late Chunking в bsl_code_v4_late коллекции?
items.expected_answer_summary: Late Chunking: эмбеддинг считается на полном документе, потом разбивается на chunks с сохранением long-range context. Использует Qwen3-Embedding-8B 4096d.

items.query: Какие коллекции Qdrant есть для retrieval после Phase 8?
items.expected_answer_summary: 10 коллекций × 4096d Qwen3: bsl_code_v4_late, bsl_code_v4, framework_code_v1, graph_embeddings, wiki_pages_v1, pdf_documents, skill_library, learned_patterns, experience_embeddings, conversation_memory.

items.query: What is the difference between Self-RAG grading and DeepEval faithfulness?
items.expected_answer_summary: Self-RAG grading is online (during inference) — agent self-checks retrieval relevance + answer hallucination. DeepEval faithfulness is offline (CI) — measures if answer is grounded in context, threshold-based.

items.query: Какой strategy выбрать для точного поиска по ключевому термину?
items.expected_answer_summary: BM25 strategy — 5ms latency, FTS5 backend с русской лемматизацией. Идеально для exact term match.

items.query: How does GraphRAG Local differ from GraphRAG Global?
items.expected_answer_summary: Local: search within a single community (1-3s). Global: map-reduce across all communities (5-15s) — broader thematic queries.

items.query: What is RRF k parameter in Hybrid Search?
items.expected_answer_summary: Reciprocal Rank Fusion smoothing parameter. Default rrf_k=60. Score = weight / (rrf_k + rank + 1).

items.query: Когда использовать MMR вместо обычного vector search?
items.expected_answer_summary: MMR — когда нужно diversity результатов (избежать повторов). Параметр diversity (λ) от 0.0 (relevance only) до 1.0 (max diversity).

items.query: What environment variables configure Langfuse?
items.expected_answer_summary: OBSERVABILITY__LANGFUSE_ENABLED, PUBLIC_KEY, SECRET_KEY, HOST через pydantic-settings nested delimiter. Legacy fallback на LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY/SECRET_KEY.

items.query: Как восстановить feedback из JSONL backup?
items.expected_answer_summary: scripts/replay_feedback_backup.py --target-db data/feedback_restored.db. Опции: --since/--until для date range, --dedupe для idempotent replay.

items.query: What is the smoke gate threshold for retrieval quality?
items.expected_answer_summary: NDCG@10 ≥ 0.55 (placeholder, calibrated against E5 baseline 0.45). Activates when golden_v1 has ≥50 items with ground truth.

items.query: Зачем нужен IDOR guard в multi-tenant API?
items.expected_answer_summary: IDOR guard блокирует non-admin доступ к чужим tenants через path/query/body tenant_id. assert_tenant_access сверяет path_tenant_id с JWT-derived current_tenant.

items.query: What does the Ralph Wiggum pattern do?
items.expected_answer_summary: Self-correcting LLM loop: 2-3 attempts where validation feedback (length, language, refusal) injects into next attempt. NOT transient retry — semantic correction.

items.query: Какие 4 декоратора предоставляет utils/retry.py?
items.expected_answer_summary: @retry_llm_call (5 attempts/120s), @retry_embedding (5/90s + RuntimeError), @retry_db_operation (3/0.5s fixed), @retry_network (4/60s). Plus create_retry() factory.

items.query: How does Adaptive RAG decide between simple and complex routing?
items.expected_answer_summary: Classifier предсказывает complexity (simple/moderate/complex). Simple → BM25 early termination ~125ms. Moderate → hybrid + reranker. Complex → decompose + multi-step.

items.query: Что такое план обмена в 1С и для чего используется?
items.expected_answer_summary: План обмена — объект 1С для распределённой работы. Регистрирует изменения объектов для последующей передачи между узлами (master/slave или peer-to-peer).

items.query: Как работает обработчик ПриЗаписи в модуле объекта?
items.expected_answer_summary: Срабатывает при сохранении объекта в БД, внутри транзакции. Параметры — Отказ (cancel) и др. Используется для validation, derived field calculation.

items.query: Как индексировать BSL код через MCP-сервер?
items.expected_answer_summary: scripts/reindex_bsl.bat — full 3-фазная BSL индексация: FTS5 BM25 + Qdrant Qwen3 4096d + Call Graph. Через bsl-semantic-search MCP server.

items.query: What chunking strategies are available in the framework?
items.expected_answer_summary: Recursive (default), Parent-Child (small/large pairs), RAPTOR (hierarchical clusters), Late Chunking (Qwen3 long context), Proposition (semantic atoms).

items.query: Как настроить TEI Docker для embedding?
items.expected_answer_summary: Docker pdf-rag-tei с Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-8B. MAX_CLIENT_BATCH_SIZE=32 (default), 4096d output. EMBEDDING__PROVIDER=tei.

items.query: What is sparse vector for in BM25 + dense hybrid retrieval?
items.expected_answer_summary: Sparse vector представляет BM25 term-frequency weights в Qdrant. Named vectors layout: dense (4096d) + bm25 (sparse). Hybrid search через RRF fusion двух prefetch.

items.query: Как работает knowledge graph в фреймворке?
items.expected_answer_summary: Entities извлекаются из chunks при индексации (--graph), хранятся в Neo4j или NetworkX. Relations + community detection (Leiden) для GraphRAG.

items.query: What does --raptor flag do during indexing?
items.expected_answer_summary: Builds hierarchical summary tree: chunks → clusters → LLM summaries (recursive). Enables high-level queries via collapsed tree search или top-down traversal.

items.query: Какие callback'и поддерживает middleware для LLM?
items.expected_answer_summary: with_middleware(llm, *handlers, enable_langfuse=True) принимает LangfuseCallbackHandler + любые BaseCallbackHandler. Поддерживает on_llm_start/end/error.

items.query: How are skills routed and activated?
items.expected_answer_summary: 4 слоя skill-router: keyword match, fuzzy match, TF-IDF similarity, semantic embedding. Bundles + affinities + scoring. Triggers через PreToolUse hooks.

items.query: What is contextual retrieval (Anthropic)?
items.expected_answer_summary: Anthropic technique: prepend chunk-level context (~50-100 tokens describing chunk's place in document) before embedding. Reduces retrieval failures by ~67% per their paper.

items.query: Как в фреймворке реализован semantic cache?
items.expected_answer_summary: Semantic cache хранит query embeddings, hit при cosine ≥ 0.95 threshold. TTL 3600s default, max_entries=5000. Кэш в data/cache/semantic_cache.db.

items.query: What are the 5 phases of Learning Loop?
items.expected_answer_summary: SEARCH (existing skill?) → FETCH (knowledge from sources) → EXECUTE (subagent + attribution) → VERIFY (knowledge-compliance) → CREATE (new skill).

items.query: Сравни v1 и v2 AutoResearch архитектуру
items.expected_answer_summary: v1: одиночный измерительный цикл measure→change→verify→keep/revert. v2: трёхагентная архитектура (Executor + Reviewer + Comparator) с blind A/B comparison и calibrated scoring.

items.query: Как использовать lazy-mcp profile для экономии контекста?
items.expected_answer_summary: Lazy-MCP — proxy для on-demand загрузки 27 серверов в 11 категориях. Активация по mention pattern. Экономит контекст vs full профиль.

items.query: Как ВызватьИсключение работает в BSL?
items.expected_answer_summary: ВызватьИсключение("сообщение") бросает исключение которое ловится ближайшим Попытка...Исключение блоком. Используется для signaling business errors.

items.query: What is the auto-reindex on commit pipeline?
items.expected_answer_summary: git post-commit hook (scripts/git_hooks) запускает re-индексацию изменённых BSL и framework файлов в Qdrant. 3-уровневое резервирование.

items.query: Почему run_id важен для cross-hook trace?
items.expected_answer_summary: run_id — UUID slash-command run, генерится UPS-хуком. Все последующие хуки (включая MCP) подхватывают через .current-runs.json. db.get_run_trace(run_id) даёт full chain.

items.query: What happens when faithfulness drops below DeepEval threshold?
items.expected_answer_summary: CI gate в test_deepeval.py падает с assertion error если faithfulness < 0.7. PR блокируется. Triggers RCA для retrieval/generation pipeline.

todo: Expand to ≥50 (activates quality gate via items_with_chunks check) and ≥100 для full benchmark. Populate expected_chunk_ids by grounding queries against actual indexed pdf_documents corpus. v2.0 may use DSPy.Synthesize when `dspy` available.
